lines: 你们要赞美耶和华！因歌颂我们的神为善为美；
赞美的话是合宜的。
你們要讚美耶和華！因歌頌我們的神為善為美；
讚美的話是合宜的。
Praise Yah
for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.

For none of us lives to himself
and none dies to himself.
